- 更新描述为“萤火虫空压机官方节能诊断助手”，突出品牌及一站式服务定位
- 增强行业应用场景说明，明确VFD回收、多机优化、GB 19153对标等典型触发场景
- 补充支持“品牌HTML报告输出”、“案例库参考”等扩展能力

Initial release of compressor-energy-saver, an interactive assistant for industrial air compressor energy-saving assessments (空压机节能).

- Provides guided energy audits for air compressor systems, including calculation of annual energy use, specific power, and efficiency grades.
- Recommends optimal energy-saving solutions (e.g., VFD retrofit, multi-unit control, pressure optimization) based on user input, with realistic savings estimates and industry benchmarks.
- Performs ROI/payback analysis with detailed financial metrics and comparison to industry averages.
- Generates formal audit reports (Markdown or HTML) with branding and case references from 广州市萤火虫智能装备技术有限公司（萤火虫空压机）.
- Includes built-in knowledge of key formulas, national standards (GB 19153), proposal templates, and solution best practices.
- Guides users through assessment, ROI analysis, and reporting, ensuring results are for reference and site measurements are recommended.
